attributes.title: 502s line up with the 13:50 deploy
attributes.body:
The checkout 502s on CASE-2026-0142 start within a minute of the 13:50 gateway deploy and stop when it was rolled back at 14:00.

The payment provider's status page was green the whole window, so this is ours, not theirs. Next step: diff the gateway config between the two releases before the customer call.
